segments.ja161:1.1: Na santhavaṃ [sandhavaṃ (ka.)] kāpurisena kayirā, ariyo anariyena pajānamatthaṃ;
segments.ja161:1.3: Cirānuvutthopi karoti pāpaṃ, gajo yathā indasamānagottaṃ.
segments.ja161:2.1: Yaṃ tveva jaññā sadiso mamanti, sīlena paññāya sutena cāpi;
segments.ja161:2.3: Teneva mettiṃ kayirātha saddhiṃ, sukho have sappurisena saṅgamoti.
